basic_info.description: Get ready to fall in love! Reminiscent of the English countryside with the English Tudor facade, large beautifully landscaped walkout backyard, & private enclosed center patio/solarium with enchanting skylight, this wonderful home provides a peaceful setting & environment. In the same family for over 88 yrs! Beautifully maintained & shows pride of ownership! Spectacular living room with dramatic vaulted beamed ceilings and fireplace, formal dining room with beamed ceiling, delightful breakfast room, & charming kitchen. The 3 bedrooms with garden outlooks are sunny with southern exposure. This fabulous home offers a great floor plan & boasts approx 2,055 sqft! The architectural detail includes lush wood detailing, crown moldings, parquet floors, high ceilings & bay windows. Superior location walking distance to the Marina Green, the bay, Fort Mason, Moscone Rec Center & Park, Chestnut Street shops & restaurants & seconds from Marina Safeway & Starbucks! Lg garage and rm for expansion.
